summary.text: Curtis Schomer is a Republican member of the Montana House of Representatives from District 48, a miner who took office in January 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election against Democrat Tucker Colvin.

paragraphs.text: Schomer's career experience includes working as a miner at the Sibanye-Stillwater mine.
In the 2025-2026 session he was assigned to the Human Services Committee and the Business and Labor Committee.
He advanced from the Republican primary on June 2, 2026.
